title: Discovering Latent Groups for Robust Classification
abstract: arXiv:2606.23609v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Machine learning models exploit spurious correlations, achieving high average accuracy but failing disproportionately on underrepresented subgroups. Existing methods address this by adjusting network parameters, guided either by subgroup annotations or inferred pseudo-group labels. Yet at inference, these methods produce only a class prediction, with no insight into a sample's latent subgroup. We propose neural classification trees (NCT), a framework that achieves robustness by encoding subgroup structure in its tree-shaped architecture. By routing each sample to an "easy" or "hard" node of this tree - based on prediction correctness - and reusing these routes as pseudo-labels for the next iteration, NCT disentangles conflicting subgroups, without requiring subgroup supervision. translated_title: 发现潜在群体以实现鲁棒分类
translated_abstract: 机器学习模型往往会利用虚假相关性，虽然能获得较高的平均准确率，但在代表性不足的子群体上却会出现不成比例的失败。现有方法通过调整网络参数来解决这一问题，其依据要么是子群体标注，要么是推断出的伪群体标签。然而在推理阶段，这些方法仅输出类别预测，无法揭示样本的潜在子群体。我们提出了神经分类树，这是一个通过在树形架构中编码子群体结构来实现鲁棒性的框架。通过基于预测正确性将每个样本路由到该树的“简单”或“困难”节点，并将这些路由结果作为下一轮迭代的伪标签，NCT无需子群体监督即可解耦相互冲突的子群体。我们在五个涵盖二元和多类虚假相关性的基准上对NCT进行评估。实验表明，学习到的树拓扑结构提供了……
tldr: 本文提出神经分类树（NCT）框架，通过在树形架构中编码子群体结构，基于预测正确性将样本路由到“简单”或“困难”节点并迭代生成伪标签，无需子群体监督即可解耦冲突子群体，实现鲁棒分类。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes neural classification trees (NCT), a framework that encodes subgroup structure in a tree-shaped architecture and iteratively routes samples to "easy" or "hard" nodes as pseudo-labels, disentangling conflicting subgroups without subgroup supervision to achieve robust classification.
